title: Drop N' Shop Event
seo_title: Drop N' Shop Kids Event in Joplin, MO on Nov 27
description: Drop N' Shop is a kids' morning at Roller City where children get skating with skate rental, unlimited laser tag, one pizza slice, one small soda, and skate assists for $20 per child, while parents can shop for the holidays or stay and join the fun. It is for kids ages 6-12, with drop-off and check-in from 10 to 10:30 AM and pick-up and check-out from 12:30 to 1 PM; space is limited. It takes place November 27, 2026 (Time TBD) at 2800 E 24th St in Joplin, MO.
